title: Configure a SharePoint Framework development environment
shortDescription: A SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web part created with the Yeoman generator for the SharePoint Framework, and tested on a modern SharePoint Online page from your local web server.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web part created with the Yeoman generator for the SharePoint Framework, and tested on a modern SharePoint Online page from your local web server.
This tutorial contains the completed code for the exercises in the Microsoft Learn module Configure a SharePoint Framework development environment.

references.name: Microsoft Learn: Configure a SharePoint Framework development environment
references.description: The Microsoft Learn training module whose exercises build the code in this tutorial.

references.name: Overview of the SharePoint Framework
references.description: The SharePoint Framework (SPFx) is a page and web part model that provides full support for client-side SharePoint development, easy integration with SharePoint data, and extending Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Viva, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.
